title: SOX9 protein in goblet cells as a critical mediator and potential therapeutic target in Barrett's esophagus: An integrated bioinformatics analysis.
authors: Yang, Lin; Deng, Jingjing; Kong, Demiao; Liu, Yixin; Li, Xiang; Guo, Wankai; Xu, Chuan; Han, Liankui; Zhou, Jianfeng
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学分析鉴定SOX9等基因作为Barrett食管诊断标志物，仅涉及分子对接的初步药物筛选，未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且缺乏AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Barrett's esophagus (BE) is the only recognized precursor to esophageal adenocarcinoma, yet current diagnostic and therapeutic strategies remain limited by sampling bias and lack of reliable molecular markers. METHODS: We conducted a multi-omics analysis using four bulk RNA-seq datasets for differential expression and WGCNA. Hub genes were identified through PPI networks and LASSO regression, validated in external cohorts. scRNA-seq profiled gene expression in epithelial and stromal subtypes, with immune profiling via CIBERSORT. SOX9 expression in single-cell resolution was validated in two BE patient cohorts. RESULTS: Five upregulated genes-SOX9, COL1A2, SPARC, EPCAM, and KRT18-were identified as robust diagnostic markers, with AUC values >0.90. scRNA-seq showed increased SOX9 expression in goblet cells in BE, which was validated by IHC. SOX9 expression in goblet cells correlated with progression to high-grade dysplasia (HGD), while expression in non-goblet cells had a lower correlation. BE tissues showed distinct immune profiles, with enriched plasma cells and CD4(+) memory T cells. Molecular docking identified potential druggable interactions with these proteins. CONCLUSION: Our integrative analysis provides a comprehensive molecular and cellular atlas of BE. These findings enhance current understanding of BE pathogenesis and offer clinically relevant candidates for early detection and targeted intervention.
abstract_zh: 背景：巴雷特食管（Barrett's esophagus, BE）是食管腺癌唯一公认的前驱病变，但当前诊断和治疗策略仍受限于取样偏差及缺乏可靠的分子标志物。方法：我们利用四个批量RNA-seq数据集进行多组学分析，包括差异表达和WGCNA。通过PPI网络和LASSO回归识别核心基因，并在外部队列中验证。scRNA-seq分析了上皮和基质亚型的基因表达，并通过CIBERSORT进行免疫谱分析。在两个BE患者队列中验证了单细胞分辨率下的SOX9表达。结果：五个上调基因——SOX9、COL1A2、SPARC、EPCAM和KRT18——被确定为稳健的诊断标志物，AUC值>0.90。scRNA-seq显示BE中杯状细胞的SOX9表达增加，并通过IHC验证。杯状细胞中SOX9表达与进展为高度不典型增生（HGD）相关，而非杯状细胞中的表达相关性较低。BE组织显示出独特的免疫谱，富集了浆细胞和CD4(+)记忆T细胞。分子对接识别了这些蛋白的潜在可成药相互作用。结论：我们的整合分析提供了BE的全面分子和细胞图谱。这些发现增强了对BE发病机制的理解，并为早期检测和靶向干预提供了临床相关候选靶点。
